title: Buttons & icons
variants: Primary, secondary, quiet, danger; small, default, large, icon-only.
states: Default, hover, focus, disabled, busy.
guidance: Enter/Space activates a button. Give icon-only buttons an accessible name. Use links for navigation.
example:
<button class="tvw-button" type="button">Save changes</button>
<button class="tvw-button tvw-button--secondary" type="button">Cancel</button>

title: Inputs & choices
variants: Text, email, date/time, range, textarea, checkbox, radio, switch and segmented radio groups.
states: Empty, populated, required, readonly, disabled, invalid; labels remain visible.
guidance: Use visible labels, fieldset/legend for related choices, and aria-describedby for help. Native keys and validation remain available.
example: Use your work address.

title: Form validation
variants: Native constraints, custom errors, asynchronous validation and cross-field rules.
states: Unsubmitted, invalid, validating, valid, service unavailable. Values survive failures.
guidance: Submit focuses a linked error summary. Correcting an input cancels stale checks. Server messages are text.

title: Cards
variants: Plain content, heading/action, image and metric compositions.
states: Static; optional child links and buttons.
guidance: Keep the heading hierarchy logical. Avoid clickable containers around nested interactive controls.

title: Badges, notices & empty states
variants: Neutral, success, danger, warning, information; empty and error panels.
states: Static information or dynamically announced updates.
guidance: Pair status colors with words. Add role=status for new nonurgent messages and role=alert only when immediate attention is needed.
example: Your changes have been saved.

title: Navigation & breadcrumbs
variants: Horizontal navigation, grouped sidebar, breadcrumbs and pagination.
states: Current page, expanded group, collapsed mobile navigation.
guidance: Use nav landmarks and aria-current. Native details/summary works with Enter and Space. Preserve ordinary links.
example: OverviewProjects

title: Accordions
variants: Independent native details; multiple sections may stay open.
states: Open, closed, focus.
guidance: Summary toggles with Enter/Space. Put headings inside the content at the appropriate level. Essential content remains in HTML.

title: Tabs
variants: Horizontal, vertical, right-to-left; automatic activation.
states: Selected tab, focused tab; all panels readable without JavaScript.
guidance: Arrows switch tabs; Home/End move to boundaries; Tab exits the tablist. Keep labels concise.

title: Dialogs & drawers
variants: Centered modal; edge-aligned detail drawer. Native dialog with reusable templates.
states: Closed, open, keyboard focus contained, focus returned on close.
guidance: Give the dialog a heading with aria-labelledby. Escape closes. Use a visible close button and concise content.

title: Menus, popovers & tooltips
variants: Action menus, supplemental content popovers and noninteractive descriptions.
states: Open, closed, focused item; disabled actions skipped.
guidance: Menus support arrows, Home/End, typeahead and Escape. Tooltips must never contain essential instructions or interactive controls.

title: Toast notifications
variants: Info, success, warning, danger; persistent or timed.
states: Visible, dismissed, timeout paused on hover/focus or hidden tab.
guidance: Use for background feedback. Important errors belong beside the affected control. Dismiss is keyboard accessible.

title: Tables, filters & pagination
variants: Search, exact filters, date range, sort, row selection, column visibility, expandable details.
states: Populated, no results, selected rows, sorted column, expanded row.
guidance: Caption and scoped headers describe data. Selection survives filtering. ISO date filters use unique names; URL persistence is opt-in.

title: Combobox & multiple selection
variants: Local options, optgroups, multiple choices, asynchronous option adapter.
states: Query, loading, matches, empty, failed with retry, selected chips, disabled, required.
guidance: Arrows highlight; Enter selects; Escape closes; Tab leaves. Native select owns submitted values. Remote requests use AbortSignal and ignore stale results.

title: Multi-step forms
variants: Ordered steps, optional back navigation, review before completion.
states: Current, completed, invalid step; data retained on Back.
guidance: Focus moves to the step heading. Hidden steps still submit their values. Use native constraints; supply application validation before final persistence.

title: Files & upload cancellation
variants: Single/multiple, drag/drop, type/size/count validation, adapter-driven progress.
states: Ready, uploading, complete, failed, cancelled; retry unfinished files.
guidance: Keep the native file input. Cancel passes a signal to the adapter; the adapter must abort its own request. Server validation remains required.

title: Progress, skeleton & region states
variants: Determinate/indeterminate progress; skeleton blocks; ready/loading/empty/error panels.
states: One region state at a time; aria-busy tracks loading.
guidance: Hide decorative skeletons from assistive technology. Give progress a label. Preserve focus when replacing a panel. Respect reduced motion.
example: <label for="progress">Upload progress</label><progress class="tvw-progress" id="progress" value="45" max="100">45%</progress>

title: Avatars & account menus
variants: Initials, image fallback, large size and avatar groups.
states: Image loaded or failed; named identity.
guidance: Name the avatar when it conveys identity; hide it when adjacent text already names the person. Account actions use the menu pattern.
example: AR

title: Application layouts
variants: Responsive header/sidebar/main, cards, grid, stack, cluster and metrics.
states: Desktop sidebar, mobile expandable navigation; content available without enhancement.
guidance: Use header/nav/main landmarks and a skip link. Test long content and 320px width. Density customization must preserve touch targets.

title: Detail lists, inline editing & activity
variants: Label/value definition lists, one-field editing, chronological activity lists.
states: Reading, editing, saving, saved, failed, cancelled.
guidance: Cancel/Escape preserves the last saved value. Save errors keep the draft focused. Use time datetime attributes for activity timestamps.

title: Accessible SVG charts
variants: Bar and line examples with an equivalent data table.
states: Static values; optional application-supplied updates.
guidance: Every figure needs a title, description and readable values. Preserve the table, and never encode a category with color alone.

title: Command palette
variants: Searchable page links or application actions in a native modal.
states: Open, filtered, no matches, focused result, closed.
guidance: Ctrl/⌘ K opens when no other modal is active. Arrow keys focus results; Enter activates; Tab remains ordinary navigation; Escape closes.

title: Theme picker
variants: Light, dark and system with sun/moon/computer icons.
states: Selected preference; multiple pickers synchronized; storage optional.
guidance: Use named buttons and aria-pressed. Native system colors still depend on the OS/browser.
